notes: Background: mid-market SaaS that embeds an AI-driven support agent across their enterprise customers (B2B SaaS).
Initial interest: started on Hosted API to validate latency/quality; now moving to Dedicated for cost predictability and VPC/data residency.
POC outcomes: 2-week hosted POC successful; chat p95 ~120ms, rerank latencies ~60-80ms, embeddings throughput met SLA for batch workflows.
Primary ask: firm committed capacity for Dedicated with burst headroom for product launches. Wants clear overage pricing and ramp credits.
Commit proposal discussed: baseline commit equivalent to ~6M tokens/month (est ~200k tokens/day) with ability to burst up to 3x for two launch months; ramp over 3 months to full commit.
Billing preference: monthly invoicing with look-back for overage; Finance pushing for graduated unit price as commitment grows (volume discounts over 12-month term).
Negotiation points outstanding: burst multipliers (3x vs 2x), overage rate (proposed 1.2x of committed unit price), whether unused commit converts to credits, and early termination clauses.
Technical constraints: want VPC peering and customer-managed KMS; E.U. data residency for a subset of customers; strict audit log retention needs (12 months).
SLA requirements: 99.9% uptime, p95 generation latency target 150ms for chat routes; want automatic fallback to smaller model on overload with configurable routing policy.
Quote from CTO (paraphrase): 'We need predictable $/concurrent session, not just token counts — if you can show predictable tail latency and unit economics we'll commit.'
Redwood asks: clarify exact commit unit (tokens vs reserved GPU-hours), agree ramp milestones, sign-off on SOW and security annex.
Procurement note: Glasswater procurement requires final pricing approval from CFO and legal signoff on SOW. Targeting April procurement cycle.
Sales strategy: propose tiered Dedicated plan (base commit, ramp months with credits, capped burst allowance) + Optimize review as add-on to lower unit cost over time.
account_summary: Glasswater Sentry Systems is a fast-growing mid-market SaaS provider of AI customer support. Completed successful Hosted API POC; now in Dedicated pricing and SOW negotiation to obtain predictable costs, VPC/ residency, and burst capacity for product launches. Decision drivers: predictable unit economics, SOC2 + KMS, clear overage rules and ramp schedule. Close targeted Q2 2026.
